title: MEX Game
statement: The task is to decide a card-drafting game: Alice and Bob alternately take cards (n even, up to 2·10^5) until each holds n/2, and Alice wins if the mex_k of their hands (smallest number appearing fewer than k times) differ. A mirror (pairing) strategy reduces it to a frequency count: the first value with fewer than 2k copies decides, and Alice wins exactly when it has 2k−1 copies.
